results.question: Melyik államból származik a legtöbb vásárló?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_state AS state,
    COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Melyik eladó értékesítette a legtöbb terméket?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS total_products_sold FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_products_sold DESC LIMIT 1;
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_id,
    s.seller_city,
    s.seller_state,
    p.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM 
    sellers s
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN 
    product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
GROUP BY 
    s.seller_id, s.seller_city, s.seller_state, p.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
    total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Melyik termékkategóriából származott a legtöbb eladás?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category, COUNT(*) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name GROUP BY COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category,
    COUNT(oi.product_id) AS total_sales
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN 
    product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
GROUP BY 
    product_category
ORDER BY 
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Hány rendelés történt 2017 januárjában?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-02-01';
results.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 1;

results.question: Melyik az 5 legdrágább termék?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, MAX(price) AS price FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.product_name_lenght,
    p.product_description_lenght,
    p.product_photos_qty,
    p.product_weight_g,
    p.product_length_cm,
    p.product_height_cm,
    p.product_width_cm,
    COALESCE(pt.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category_name
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

results.question: Melyik vásárló adta le a legtöbb rendelést?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY 
    order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
